content: Hybrid deterministic-rules + LLM orchestration is the emerging consensus for regulated decisioning (HackerNoon, Adnan Masood, Simplai, Elementum, AWS Prescriptive Guidance). Core claim: 'LLMs make better orchestrators than operators' - the deterministic substrate underneath the model is what gets audited. Pattern: LLM handles language, extraction, and orchestration; a rules engine/rule substrate handles the decision and the audit trail (neuro-symbolic). Variants: Sequential Validation (LLM interprets -> deterministic validation), Deterministic Peer Nodes (agents, bots, APIs, rules, human tasks as equal peers in a fully deterministic process model), 80/20 hybrid (80% deterministic, 20% agent judgement). Rule-engine algorithms: Rete, PHREAK, TREAT, Datalog, DMN, CEP. Mitigate architectural misfit by never treating an LLM as the end-to-end decision system in a regulated domain.
